observable_truths.description: With a DONE+completed_at (archived) task left in state.json, node bin/gos.cjs gate all exits 0 and prints one coverage idle advisory and one semantic idle advisory, each carrying the gos init hint; standalone gate coverage and gate semantic behave the same; --json reports verdict pass with the idle lines in advisories

A live task with a stale run-manifest still fails gate all (exit 1, manifest-stale), and a bare-DONE state without completed_at keeps task-level checks live - the downgrade is exclusive to the archived window
